title: Task API — CRUD, validation, and a live summary
intent: A small HTTP task-tracking service: create, list, read, update and delete tasks, and report how many are done.

runtime.brief:
Write a TypeScript project whose entrypoint is `src/server.ts`, started with `npx tsx src/server.ts` from the project root.
- Listen on the port in the environment variable PORT (always set; do not pick your own).
- Persist to a SQLite file at the path in the environment variable DB_PATH (always set; create the schema on startup if it is missing).
- The only dependencies available are: hono, @hono/node-server, better-sqlite3, zod, and the Node standard library. Nothing else is installed and no install step will run.
- Do not write a package.json, a lockfile, or a tsconfig.json; the runtime is already configured.
- The process must stay running and answer requests until it is killed.
- Expose `GET /health`, answering 200 as soon as the service is ready: the harness uses it to detect readiness and will give up on a service that never answers it.
